_meta.source: Derived from enshroudedguides.com/beginner-guide.html and guide pages

stages.name: Early Game
stages.description: Survival basics, tutorial, first NPC rescues, and establishing your first base.

recommended_actions.detail: Follow the tutorial path out of the starting crypt. Commune with The Flame.
Craft with 5 Stone. Choose a flat area outside the Shroud near wood, stone, and water.
Stone Axe (wood cutting) + Stone Pickaxe (mining). Craft at Workbench (5 Wood, 2 Nails).
Walls + roof for NPCs to function. Does not need to be elaborate yet.
Ancient Vault north of Cinder Vault (-150, 80). Craft Summoning Staff (1 Twig) first.
8 Shroud Wood + 6 String + 2 Shroud Spores at Blacksmith. #1 priority item.
4 Metal Scraps + 4 String + 2 Wood at Blacksmith. Unlocks vertical exploration.
Ancient Vault west of Springlands Spire (-260, -40). Unlocks potions and alchemy.

recommended_actions.action: Unlock Double Jump and Water Aura
recommended_actions.detail: First 3-4 skill points: Survivor (Double Jump, Dessert Stomach) → Healer (Water Aura, Battle Heal).
5 Shroud Liquid + 10 Stone + 5 Wood. Extends Shroud timer to 3-4 minutes.

stages.name: Mid Game
stages.description: Expanding your base, rescuing remaining NPCs, entering Revelwoods, and defeating your first bosses.

recommended_actions.detail: Carpenter, Farmer, and Hunter. Each adds essential crafting stations and upgrades.
10 Shroud Liquid + 5 Shroud Spores + 15 Stone + 10 Wood. Required for Iron crafting tier.
Recommended level 5-6 minimum. New biome with harder enemies, Iron nodes, and hardwood.

recommended_actions.action: Establish a forward base in Revelwoods
recommended_actions.detail: Place a second Flame Altar near the biome border. Forest Edge (400, -50) or Lake Overlook (550, -220).

recommended_actions.action: Upgrade to Iron weapons and armor
recommended_actions.detail: Craft Noble Sword, Fell Axe, or Scorching Wand at Blacksmith. Upgrade armor to Guard of the North or Mercenary.
Springlands boss. Level 6-7 recommended. Bring 50+ arrows. Rewards: Warden's Chest Key, Runes.

recommended_actions.action: Destroy Shroud Roots for skill points
recommended_actions.detail: Each Shroud Root grants +1 to +3 permanent skill points. Check map.html for coordinates.
Healer: Blink (teleport dodge). Assassin: Updraft (jump height). Core mobility skills.
Revelwoods flying boss. Level 15 recommended. Use ranged weapons. Rewards: Wyvern Scale, Rare Gear.
Choose a build direction: Melee Tank, Mage DPS, or Archer Assassin. Begin allocating skills accordingly.

stages.name: Late Game
stages.description: High-level zones, Steel crafting tier, major bosses, and preparation for endgame content.

recommended_actions.detail: Level 20+ recommended. Rich in Iron, Copper, and rare materials. Highland Mesa base recommended (950, -700).
Required for Steel crafting tier and Kindlewastes access.
Wailing Blade, Ignited Bow, Guardian Shield — the S/A-Tier weapons require Steel.
Revelwoods poison boss. Level 20. Bring Shroud Survival Flasks. Fast weapons recommended.
Nomad Highlands boss. Level 25. Kill adds first, save burst for berserk phase.
Springlands Hollow Halls. Requires Level 4 Flame + all 5 core NPCs. Unlocks Shroud crafting.
Level 25+ desert biome. Harsh conditions, rare water sources, endgame materials.

recommended_actions.action: Max out your build's core skills
recommended_actions.detail: Complete your 20-point skill allocation based on your chosen build. Full build guides at /builds/.
Elder Set, Radiant Paladin, Eagle Eye — these scale 13-25 and are worth farming now.
Sunken Ancient City (Blackmire). Requires Level 12+ and Revelwood Spire. Unlocks Large Backpack (+24).

stages.name: End Game
stages.description: Max level content. Fell Dragon, Hollow King, legendary farming, and build optimization.

recommended_actions.detail: Required for legendary crafting and endgame content access.
Wailing Blade (Fell Dragon ~15%), Dragonbone Bow (~20%), Hollow King's Scepter (~10%).
Sunpiercer (Heavy Tank), Eagle Eye L25 (Ranger), Hailcaster/Radiance (Mage).
Kindlewastes multi-phase boss. Max prep required: fire resist gear, 10+ Greater Healing Potions, max food buffs.
Shroud Depths secret boss. Wand/Bow recommended. Kill shadow clones immediately.
Reclear bosses on respawn for Dragon Scales, legendary blueprints, and runes.
Slot optimal gems (Currents for mage, Cutting for melee, Corruption for assassin). Max 4 food buffs with Dessert Stomach.
Every permanent skill point counts. Deep Shroud Root gives +3. Total ~184 skill points achievable.
With all NPCs, max Flame Altar, and abundant resources — build the ultimate fortress.
Stockpile runes, materials, and max all NPCs. The 1.0 launch (October 2026) may add new content.
